name: Bella Strada
title: Bella Strada Window Cleaning, Gated Enclave | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning in Bella Strada, the newer gated enclave beside Costa Bella. One acre plus lots, pure water poles and soft wash for stone.
h1_em: Newer homes, clear glass, no film.
intro: Bella Strada is a smaller gated enclave right next to Costa Bella, with homesites of an acre or more. CleanzATX cleans windows and soft washes exteriors here, and Tyler Durham handles each estimate and visit.

sections.h2: What Bella Strada homes are like
paragraphs: This is a newer, small enclave, so the homes feel fresh and well kept. Homesites are an acre or larger, and prices run from $1.35M to $3.5M. Residents also have marina access through the neighboring Costa Bella community. Because it is newer, the landscaping is still filling in on many lots and the stucco and stone are not old.

A gate controls entry. That keeps traffic low, and it also means we plan around access when we book. The setting is close to Lakeway, so it is an easy fit with the rest of our route in the 78734 area.

sections.h2: What Bella Strada windows deal with
paragraphs: Newer homes mean large panes, tall ceilings and a lot of glass facing outward. Fresh construction also leaves behind a different set of problems than old homes do: fine dust from nearby building, paint overspray or sticker residue now and then, and caulk smears at frames. Pure water handles loose dust well. Tougher residue needs a closer look on a case by case basis.

Sprinklers throw mineral rich water on lower windows, and within a season you may see white spotting at the base of the glass. If you are within reach of the lake, mist can add to it. Removing hard water spots costs $10 a pane.

Give us the gate code or contact when you book, and we will confirm the day by text. Water fed poles let us reach up to three stories from the ground, so we do not set ladders on new sod or landscaping beds. Pairing the windows with a house soft wash makes sense once the stone and stucco have a year or two of weather on them. Our 12V soft wash system is the same one we use on roofs.
A 4,000 sq ft home here would run about $400 for exterior windows at $0.10 per sq ft. Plan on about three to four hours on site for the outside of a house that size.

why: Small gated enclave, so booking is one text and one gate code
Newer homes with large panes that show film and streaks fast
One acre lots, so we plan longer visits for a single house
Close to Lakeway, so it fits neatly into our 78734 route

faq.q: Is Bella Strada part of Costa Bella?
faq.a: It is a separate gated enclave that sits next to Costa Bella, and residents get marina access through Costa Bella. We treat it as its own stop and quote each home by its size.

faq.q: My home is new. Does it still need cleaning?
faq.a: Usually yes. New homes collect construction dust, irrigation spots and pollen quickly, and glass often has leftover residue from the build. We look at it first and tell you what pure water can and cannot remove.

faq.q: What do I do about the gate?
faq.a: Text us the code or the name of the contact who can let us in. We handle the rest, and we only ask for access for the day of the job.

faq.q: What does a typical visit cost?
faq.a: Outside glass is $10 a window, or roughly $0.10 per sq ft. Add the inside and the price is $15 per window. The minimum job is $200. Quotes come back by text, normally inside an hour on a business day.

faq.q: Can you also wash the roof and stone?
faq.a: Yes. Roof soft wash starts at $0.25 per sq ft with a $400 minimum, and house soft wash at $0.20 per sq ft. Neither involves harsh pressure on limestone or stucco.
